szene: In a small apartment bathroom, Resi sits cross-legged on the tiled floor in front of a running front-loading washing machine, watching the drum spin as if it were television, chin resting on her hand. Herbert hangs upside down from the towel rail right next to her head, also watching.

Inside a Vienna U-Bahn carriage during the day, Resi sits on a seat by the window with her hands in her lap, deadpan, while other passengers stand around her looking at their phones. Herbert sits on her shoulder and looks out of the window.
